get.description: Get the barcodes for a Mercury transaction.

parameters.name: mercuryTransactionId
parameters.description: The Mercury transaction ID for the order.

parameters.name: X-Identity-Context
parameters.description: Header identifying the broker ID to perform the operation for. Format: 'broker-id=##[;user-id=##]'

404.description: The Mercury transaction does not exist or there are no barcodes available for the Mercury transaction.

get.summary: Gets the PDF representing the tickets for a Mercury transaction.
get.description:
The eTickets for a Mercury transaction are stored in a single PDF with one page per eTicket.
            The PDF data is in the form of a base64-encoded string.
            HTTP status codes:
            200 for success.
            404 if the eTickets for the Mercury transaction are not in TicketVault.

parameters.name: mercuryTransactionId
parameters.description: The ID of the Mercury transaction for which the eTickets are to be retrieved.

parameters.name: X-Identity-Context
parameters.description: Header identifying the broker ID to perform the operation for. Format: 'broker-id=##[;user-id=##]'

404.description: The Mercury transaction does not exist or there are no eTickets available for the Mercury transaction.

post.summary: Uploads the PDF representing the tickets for a Mercury transaction.
post.description:
Uploads the PDF and attaches it to the associated Mercury transaction ID. If there are already eTickets attached, the call will fail.
            After eTickets are attached, they will be available to the buyer.
            The request body is provided using the multipart/form-data content type.

parameters.name: mercuryTransactionId
parameters.description: The ID of the Mercury transaction that the eTickets will be associated with.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The PDF file attachment.

parameters.name: file_size
parameters.description: The length of the file, in bytes.

parameters.name: file_hash
parameters.description: The MD5 hash of the file in hexadecimal notation. (e.g. "f877a5b6a0a403a44575308a69a96073")

parameters.name: pdf_low_to_high
parameters.description: Only applies to Mercury orders. If true, the pages in the attached PDF are arranged from low to high seat numbers; if false, they are arranged from high to low. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: X-Identity-Context
parameters.description: Header identifying the broker ID to perform the operation for. Format: 'broker-id=##[;user-id=##]'

400.description: Invalid input data. Check the response for a detailed error.

415.description: The request must use the multipart/form-data format.

post.description: This call confirms that tickets have been transferred to the customer for an order, and optionally allows proof of delivery to be uploaded. This call is intended to be used for any delivery method where TicketNetwork does not otherwise have visibility into ticket delivery (i.e. anything other than physical shipping methods with a tracking number, E-Ticket, Upload QR Screenshot, or TN Digital Conversion) to ensure prompt payment for the order. If successful, the HTTP response code will indicate a 204 (No Content) response.

parameters.description: The Mercury transaction identifier.

parameters.name: ticketSourceId

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: A JPEG, PNG, or PDF file containing proof of delivery for an order.

parameters.description: Header identifying the broker ID to perform the operation for. Format: 'broker-id=##[;user-id=##]'

415.description: The request must use the multipart/form-data format.
